Superseded by the BINDING `epm:review-reconcile v1` verdict (2026-08-31T02:47:14Z), which upheld the Claude PASS and demoted this Critical.

MECHANISM CONFIRMED by the reconciler's own live probe, not taken on either reviewer's word: `subprocess.run(text=True, errors="replace")` translated raw `A\r\nB\rC\nD` to `A\nB\nC\nD`, and `b'\xff'` / `b'\xfe'` decoded to identical strings; both endpoint reads route through it (`scripts/check_cited_body_currency.py:758-759` -> `_git` at `:246-252` -> the equality check at `:709-717`). Codex's mechanism report was the more complete of the two — the Claude Minor missed the newline-translation leg entirely.

REACHABILITY REFUTED for this consumer, which is why the severity does not hold: the repo sets `core.autocrlf = input` (CRLF cleaned at commit), and an empirical corpus scan found 0 of 2,887 `body.md` blobs at HEAD and 0 of 7,265 blob versions over the last 120 days carrying any CR byte or invalid UTF-8. Task bodies are written by Python text-mode UTF-8 writes, which cannot produce either shape. The nearest realistic trigger (a whole-file EOL normalization commit) self-guards via the mode-only check at `:717`.

HARM BOUND: loud, not silent. The label is advisory — `check` returns STALE regardless — and unlike `rename-only`, `frontmatter-only` does NOT suppress the diff (`:764`), so a false label would sit directly beside the displayed body hunks.

NOT DISMISSED: carried forward at CONCERN severity as `lossy-decode-endpoint-read`, with the fix direction both reviewers converged on (bytes-mode capture for the two `git show` CONTENT reads, keeping #2384's fail-soft `errors="replace"` decoding for log / diff / subject reads). Round 2 addresses that concern — autonomous mode never defers a CONCERN (Step 5c-ter).
